name: FluxTransit Profile
description: Gold graph for the FluxTransit ProfilePage (source-backed: XAML + MVUX model + FluxStyles). Kit v0.4 altitude. Gold v1.1: canonical renamed glass-panel -> card per the kit's own Pass-8 vocabulary (defect found by blind runs).

evidence.rationale: Back button + heading grid at top.
Icon button bound to the GoBack command.
Three sections share FluxGlassPanelStyle (glass bg, subtle border, radius 24, padding 24).
120x80 indigo card visual; brand text + bound masked number.
Bound to OpusBalance with a literal $ run.
Bound to UpdateBalance; hidden while IsRefreshing.
IState<bool> IsRefreshing toggles the button/progress swap during UpdateBalance.
Two identical route rows: transit icon, name over stations, chevron.
Outlined full-width button; no command or click handler bound.

nodes.name: API key helper
nodes.text: Get your API key from ai.google.dev

evidence.rationale: Single-select chip group; EN literal-checked in XAML.
IsOn=True literal; not bound to any state.
IsRefreshing swaps the update button for the progress row inside this section.
UpdateBalance sets IsRefreshing true for the duration of the refresh.

unresolved.question: Where does Back navigate?
possibleValues: previous screen on the navigation stack
unresolved.reason: GoBack delegates to INavigator.GoBack; the destination depends on the runtime stack, not a declared screen.

unresolved.question: What does Add New Route do?
unresolved.reason: The button has no Command or Click handler in the source.

unresolved.question: What invokes the declared SaveSettings command?
unresolved.reason: ProfileModel.SaveSettings exists but nothing in the page binds it.

unresolved.question: Are the language chips and alerts toggle meant to bind to model state?
possibleValues: bind to SelectedLanguage / a notifications state
unresolved.reason: Chip IsChecked and ToggleSwitch IsOn are XAML literals; SelectedLanguage exists in the model but is unused by the page.
